Messages.Author: Kenneth
Messages.Body:
Does anyone have some numbers on the distribution of rares, uncommons,
and commons in the orginal Jyhad starter packs. Also, are some cards
limited to the booster packs or are they all available in the starters?
-Kenneth

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


1 rare per booster, 2 rares per starter deck.

I don't know the rest of the breakdown for a starter deck, but the
boosters have 3 uncommons, 4 vampires, and 11 commons.

All cards are available in both.
